Fixed CI Trivy tags, PHP version mismatch, Playwright metadata, Reverb E2E environment, full Pint gate, and added Flutter CI.
Updated Docker Compose to build the backend image and added a Redis queue worker.

Formatted the complete PHP codebase with Pint.
Added a public, responsive, CSS-3D animated landing page at the guest root with keyboard-accessible mobile navigation, dynamic sign-in/dashboard CTA, and reduced-motion support.
Redesigned the login, dashboard shell, cards, tables, filters, forms, dialogs, and responsive navigation into a cohesive premium visual system without changing API or authorization behavior.
Fixed dashboard modal layering so dialogs render above the sticky topbar and hardened E2E selectors against ambiguous visible labels.

Completed a second UI/UX QA pass across desktop and Pixel 7: removed login and dashboard horizontal clipping, added table scroll affordance and sticky actions, raised important touch targets, and prevented stretched dashboard cards.

Simplified CRUD workflows by rendering only resource-relevant filters, grouping exports and advanced tools into compact menus, scoping permission/queue tools to relevant resources, and translating common fields and statuses to Indonesian.

Hardened interaction accessibility with Escape/focus-trap/focus-restore behavior for the mobile drawer and primary dialogs, linked CRUD validation errors to fields, and added keyboard/outside-click lifecycle support to the landing mobile menu.

Made CRUD search results race-safe by ignoring stale requests and loading list plus analytics concurrently; dashboard previews now use explicit human-oriented columns instead of arbitrary first fields.

Connected owner dashboard previews to enriched tenant membership, module, and subscription DTOs; mobile toolbar menus are viewport-safe and mutually exclusive, while row actions stay compact without sticky overlap.
Made composer run dev cross-platform: Unix keeps Laravel Pail, while Windows automatically tails storage/logs/laravel.log without requiring the unavailable pcntl extension.

Fixed local Vite CSP loading by deriving development sources from public/hot, allowing HMR connections only in local mode, and binding Vite/HMR to CSP-compatible 127.0.0.1; production CSP remains unchanged.
Reduced shared Inertia payloads per dashboard/module, added tenant-role caching, and reduced representative dashboard queries from 232-630 to 19-36 with payload reductions of 67-86 percent.
Fixed Redis tenant cache serialization so cache entries contain arrays/scalars instead of framework objects and Collections.
Added CRUD contract coverage for create/read/update/delete, validation, relation labels, tenant isolation, and permission behavior across resources and roles.
Added local MinIO integration for signed URLs, queued import/export, backup objects, and lifecycle validation; S3-compatible integration remains opt-in outside the local stack.
Added isolated E2E databases/shards and Grafana monitoring for slow queries, queue latency/runtime/depth, error rate, and Reverb connections.

Replaced the CSS pseudo-3D landing hero with a full-bleed procedural Three.js campus, scroll-linked camera, pointer parallax, reduced-motion behavior, WebGL fallback, and render suspension while outside the viewport.

Refined login and every backend role/module into a denser operational visual system with responsive two-column mobile toolbars, stronger contrast, stable wrapping, compact cards, and accessible controls.

Removed fabricated CRUD insight percentages and timestamps, fixed the owner profile route, added keyboard-complete tabs, and repaired modal focus trap, Escape, focus restoration, accessible names, and mobile drawer initial focus.
Removed the workspace stacking context that placed CRUD and administration modals behind the sticky topbar and caused header elements to intercept modal actions.
Enriched operational dashboard DTOs so schedules, invoices, students, and medical records display class, subject, student, room, and doctor text instead of raw relation IDs.

Added a permanent screenshot audit runner that covers landing, login, every role dashboard, and every menu on desktop Chromium and Pixel 7 while checking status codes, document overflow, control clipping, and Three.js frame/scroll behavior.
